description:
What success looks like in this role: 
 
 We’re looking for a motivated ServiceNow Developer with integration experience to join our ServiceNow Integration team. This role involves scripting and building ticket-exchange (eBonding) integrations between ServiceNow and third-party applications using ShareLogic Unifi, and supporting those integrations once they are live.

 Skill Set: 
 ServiceNow platform development (server-side and client-side JavaScript, Script Includes, Business Rules, Flow Designer)
 ShareLogic Unifi (Integration Designer, integrations, messages, actions, heartbeat monitoring)
 eBonding / ticket-exchange integrations (Incident, Request, Change, Problem)
 REST and SOAP web services (inbound and outbound), Scripted REST APIs
 JSON, XML and XSD / WSDL
 ServiceNow IntegrationHub, Import Sets, Transform Maps and MID Server
 Authentication and security (OAuth 2.0, Basic, API keys, mTLS, credential management)
 Protocols (HTTP/HTTPS, SFTP) and asynchronous messaging patterns
 ITSM processes and the ServiceNow data model
 Automated Test Framework (ATF) and integration testing
 Source control, update sets / scoped apps and DevOps practices
 Working knowledge of B2B / multi-vendor integration domain
 Experience integrating with Jira, Azure DevOps, Salesforce or other ITSM platforms – will be an added advantage
 ServiceNow certifications (CSA, CAD) – will be an added advantage
  
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 Build and customize ticket-exchange integrations using ShareLogic Unifi Integration Designer, from no-code configuration to pro-code scripting.
 Develop integrations between ServiceNow and various end-point applications, including bi-directional sync of states, comments, work notes and attachments.
 Build and unit test services and integration scripts, using stubs / mock endpoints.
 Create reusable integration templates (golden images) to speed up partner and customer onboarding.
 Participate in test case execution (SIT / UAT) and carry out investigation by analysing integration logs, message payloads and HTTP requests.
 Monitor integration health, handle failed or stuck messages, replay transactions and resolve integration issues.
 Support Unifi and ServiceNow upgrades by regression-testing integrations.
 Maintain integration documentation and follow ServiceNow development best practices.
 
 
 You will be successful in this role if you have: 
 The successful candidate will be part of a team responsible for the ongoing enhancement and maintenance of the ServiceNow Integrations platform and must be able to act with a sense of urgency and adapt to changing priorities.
  
 Around 2-6 years of experience in ServiceNow development with integration tools
 Hands on technical knowledge in at least one of the following:
 ServiceNow REST / SOAP integrations and IntegrationHub
 ShareLogic Unifi, or other eBonding / ticket-exchange integration platforms
 Knowledge of SQL queries and database concepts
 Knowledge of cloud-native solutions using Azure / AWS / Google Cloud
 Good written and verbal communication, including with external technical teams
 Acts with a sense of urgency and is a problem solver.
